content: Raakuukaŋ Yeesu
Ŋ jamanoocaam, buura yakkaŋ Rom teeksee Ogis nakohha ne tiik caŋ ɓooɓa jen fiissaat.
Fiisiŋ tiik ceem nikka wa koc, wa hendee ŋ jamanoona Kiriñus nikoh goornooraŋ Siri.
Ŋ ineem, yaa nu nga ɗah, kaɗeeɗa ne a fiisu ŋ kur ka a cosaankoh.
Suseef nammba puloh kur ka na woyse Nasareet ŋ Galile, a kaɗta Betlehem ŋ Yudee, kur ɓi Dawuuda laam a ɓaahee ŋ ɓi rimkoh nga ɗe.
A kaɗta bindka na ɓitiice Maryaama tel ɗe rook.
Noha a joy ɓasloh raak ɓa reyiɗ Betlehem,
a ɓasilla kuɓu ƴaar saawiŋ ɗe, a lemessa ɗe ŋ daah. Ina ɓa haɓeeɗi ŋ dalohaanaŋ hanheeca, tahha po a faannda ɗe ŋ ñamohaanaŋ ɗoopaat ca.
Malaaka teeɓkiɗ niiɗoh ca
Ŋ bilaf faŋ kur ka, ɓi niiɗoh meeɗeen neeh nga ne ɓa taambkoh ɗoopaat caŋ ɓa.
Malaaka teeɓukka ɓa, siñaariŋ Heɗ ɓoo yipukka nga ɓa, ɓa feyuusa lool.
Waaye malaakaana woosa ɓa ne : « Kinaat neƴƴoh, ŋ kom ɗu woo neɓiɗ wi fu inah ne ɓooɓi jen hey sume nga keeh-keeh.
Woti ŋ kur ɓi Dawuuda, Mucɗoh wuu ɗu rimkiɗ nga ; a yi Kiristaani, weɗ Heɗ ɓoo, Mucɗohi Kooh gapohe.
Inii weɗ na hee ɗu wa teeɓe : Ɗu hey hote kuɓu lemesuuɗ ŋ daah, a faanu ŋ ñamoha ɗoopaat. »
Ɗekka po, mboolo malaaka laayoh na laayoh nikka na ya koc ŋ ɗiska, ca ƴeekeeɗa Kooh an :

content.text: ŋ ɗiska uup ɗafuk ŋ Eel ca

content: Wa malaakaaca faɗ ɓa ndaam, dokukka Eel ca, niiɗoh ca woosa ŋ harmban ɓa ne : « Ɓoo kaɗaat Betlehem, marka ini raak nga, wi Heɗ ɓoo woo. »
Ɓa arra kaɗ, ɓa raakka Maryaama na Suseef nga na kuɓka faanuuɗ ŋ ñamoha ɗoopaat.
Wa ɓa hot kuɓka, ɓa naandsukka ɓooɓa ini ɓa woyu nga ɗe.
Ɓooɓa kerah naandsukaŋ niiɗoh ca jen feyuusa.
Ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Maryaama, a ammba woo ceem jen ŋ hafiŋ ɗe, a markiseeɗa ca ŋ ɗooƴ ce.
Niiɗoh ca dokkeeɗa, ɓa ƴeekeeɗa yakkiŋ Kooh, ŋ ina ɓa kerah te ɓa hottaa laam wa raakoh ɗaa findi ɓa woyohsee wa.
Yeesu teeɓohuuɗ ŋ Kahan Kooh
Wa mbeha Maryaama ɓasloh dokuk, kuɓka nguɗukka ; ɓa teekka ɗe Yeesu, tiika malaakaana eɗohee bala yaay ɓa amban rook.
Wa neeh ca ɓa farsukohee reeh findi waasiŋMusaa nakoha, ɓa ɓayya kuɓka Yerusalem ne ɓa eɗ ɗe Heɗ ɓoo.
Laam, ŋ waasiŋ Heɗ ɓoo, wa fiisuuɗ ne : « Komaaki saaw ƴaar nu nik ɗah, Heɗ ɓoo hey ɗe waɗse. »
Ɓa nammba seeƴuk ne Maryaama hool findi wa nakohu ŋ waasiŋ Heɗ ɓoo : hoɗ kanak mbaa banuut ƴin kanak.
Simeyong na Aana yakɗiɗ Kooh sagu Yeesu
Ŋ Yerusalem, raakiɗ ƴaara teeksee Simeyong nga, a nikee ƴaar yurhiɗ te a kerhiɗta Kooh, a nikee sekeeɗa mbehi Israayel hirpohsan. Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani, Fuuɗsiŋ Kooh nikee na Simeyong.
A teeɓeen ɗe ne bala a kaanan ɗah, a hey hote Mucɗohi Gapohse Heɗ ɓoo woos.
Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani hiirra ɗe ŋ kaɗ Kahan Kooh, raak Maryaama na Suseef ɓayiɗ Yeesu ne ɓa wik ɗe Kooh findi waasiŋ Musaa nakoha.
Simeyong ammba gooya, a yakiɗta Kooh, an :

content.text: « Ɗiski wa nik ndii Heɗ ɓoo,
fu miniɗ faɗ ñaamiŋ ɗa a coot ŋ jam.
ŋ hotootiɗ Mucɗohi puloh nga ɗa
a nikka ñiini na hee ɗa teeɓohe ŋ cuuɓ ci jen,
te a yi ndamiŋ Israayel, cuuɓiŋ ɗa. »

content: Baabiŋ kuɓki na yaay ɓa feyuusa ŋ in ci Simeyong woo nga ɗe,
Simeyong barke'iɗta ɓa, a hannda woo Maryaama, yaayi ne : « Kuɓkii hay ne, ɓi ɓo' laayiɗ ŋ Israayel keen, laayiɗ kuruk. A hey nike firndeeni na hee taasse.
Ŋ ineem, liiɓ ci ɓo' laayiɗ ɗasiɗ ŋ ɗooƴ ɓa hey teeɓohse. Te fu Maryaama, fu hey raake miskiɗ findi ɓoyi yipu salma ŋ keeñ. »
Wa nameen raak woosuuɗ ɓitiɓ teeku Aana, a nikee kuɓu Fanuwel yi ɓaahee ŋ cuuɓiŋ Aser. A ɓitfeen lool ; wa kilookiŋ ɗe coot, a pesiɗ kiis yasna-kanak na ƴaar ce, yeem kaannda,
a rissa raakaaɗi ƴaar. A raakee kiis ndaŋkiyaah-yasna-kaahay na kiis nikiis (84). A meeɗɗi kurkoh ŋ Kahnaŋ Kooh, a oreeɗa, a kiimeeɗa Kooh noh na wek ; a nikiɗohee ɗe ɗaa.
A maasoheen wa Simeyong na woye, a nammba gidim Kooh, a woyeeɗa ɓooɓa seke faɗsuukiŋ Yerusalem jen ini kaɗ ŋ kuɓka.
Wa Suseef na Maryaama ƴut haɓiɗ in ci waasiŋ Heɗ ɓoo nakoh jen, ɓa dokukka Galile, ŋ kur ɓa wi na woyse Nasareet.
Kuɓka yakeeɗa, a ndengeeɗa, a ɓaateeɗa raak liiɓohaaɗ moɗiɗ te Kooh hunnda na ɗe.
Yeesu ŋ Yerusalem
Kiis nu ree ɗah, Maryaama na Suseef kaɗ Yerusalem ne ɓa maasoh Paak ci, mbeh ci ɓa na naandsukohe pulohaŋ Israayel ci Misra.
Wa Yeesu raak kiis ndaŋkiyaah na kiis kanak (12), a kaɗta na ɓa findi wa na tumohse.
Wa hewa reeh, ɓa haadeeɗa, waaye a yi Yeesu, a tassa ŋ Yerusalem. Yaay ɓa na baab ɓa yegɗi.
Ɓa liiɓpa haa ne a yaa ŋ huntoh caŋ ɓa ɓinooɓa, ɓa tiinnda ini ree noh mulnguus, ɓa hotɗi ɗe. Ɓa marakka ɗe ŋ nawleecaŋ ɓa na ɓaah caŋ ɓa.
Ɓa hotɗi ɗe, ɓa dokukka, ɓa waakeeɗa ɗe po ŋ ɗooƴ Yerusalem.
Ŋ mbeha kaahayɗoh, ɓa raakka ɗe ɓoofiɗ ŋ ɗooƴ Kahan Kooh ŋ leernaŋ jangɗohoh ca ; a sikɗukeeɗa ɓa, a nameeɗa ɓa meekis.
Ɓooɓa kerhee ɗe jen feyuusa ŋ neɓkiŋ ɗe hel, na findi a lofohee ɓa.
Wa yaay ɓa na baab ɓa hot ɗe, ɓa feyuusa. Yaay ɓa woosa ɗe ne : « Kuɓkiŋ ngo wa ye tah, fu haɓiɗta ɓoo inii ? Mi na baab ɗu, ɓoo feysee feyu, ɓoo ɓii waak ɗa poyi. »
A loffa ɓa ne : « Wa ye tah ɗu waakeeɗa so ? Hanaa ɗu inahɗi ne, ŋ joy nik ŋ Kahan Baabiŋ ngo ? »
Waaye ɓa inahɗi ini a woo ɓa.
Ŋ ineem Yeesu hunnda na ɓa, ɓa dokukka kur ka na woyse Nasareet. Ŋ ineem, a kerhiɗeen ɓa, yaay ɓa ammba in ceem jen ŋ hafiŋ ɗe.
Yeesu yakeeɗa, a uupeeɗa uup raak liiɓohaaɗ moɗiɗ, a neɓpa ɓooɓa, a neɓpa Kooh.
